method: Built-in image tool, three large magenta-backed alternatives

prompts.a: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw one large square source painting for a top-down pixel-art FOG weather overlay, on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta background. This is a material mask for reduction to 192x192 native pixels, not a landscape scene. Make a seamless-looking all-over irregular field occupying 45 percent of the square, with broad quiet overlapping fog planes and irregular clear magenta spaces. Very low, broad, flat torn layers of mist, each mass roughly 40-100 native pixels wide and 15-40 native pixels deep. Several planes join and overlap across the composition. Uneven distribution and varied bank lengths; no rows, no regularly repeating openings, no diagonal corridor. Draw into all four edges, with no border or margin. Four flat solid drawing colours only: muted blue grey #AD BFC5 (use #ADBFC5), #C8D6D8, #E1E8E6, #F1F3EB. The darkest shade covers most of every bank, middle shade makes long broad quiet flat terraces, only a few tiny brighter inner planes, no bright tips or bright rims. Top-left light extremely subdued. Use rectilinear stair-step square pixel clusters, flat interior planes without texture. No rounded puffs, clouds, curls, hooks, wave crests, whitecaps, scallops, teeth, tendrils, dashes, specks, dots, noise, dithering, outlines, blur, gradients, haze outside the drawn banks, or antialiasing. The magenta stays perfectly solid. Avoid many small isolated marks: think a very sparse cut-paper aerial map of overlapping broad mist strata. No text or grid lines. Full canvas 1536x1536 or larger, square.
prompts.b: Use case: stylized-concept. A production pixel-art asset atlas containing SIX completely separate flat mist strata on solid uniform #FF00FF magenta. Arrange in two columns and three rows, each drawing contained within its own cell with magenta margin, no labels or grid. Each stratum will be reduced to a wide 100x48-pixel fog fragment for a top-down map; paint it at large resolution. Draw shallow, broad, overlapping flat fog planes, low and restrained, like a torn soft atmospheric veil viewed directly from overhead. All six have DIFFERENT asymmetrical lengths and irregular angular silhouettes, some forked, some with deep broad recesses, some offset terraces, no same shape repetition. Each has only 3 or 4 large planes, no internal texture. About 70% of each stratum in flat muted blue-grey #ADBFC5, 25% as large subdued inner shelves #C8D6D8, a little #E1E8E6 on the upper left, almost no #F1F3EB. These colours are opacity codes, so never shade or gradient them. Contours use small crisp rectilinear native 1-pixel stair steps, natural asymmetric outlines but square pixels. NOT cartoon puffy clouds, NOT whitecaps, no curls or hooks, NO bright crest/rim/teeth, NO clusters of tiny marks, NO disconnected specks, NO noise, no stipple, NO wispy thin tails, no rounded bulb lobes, no drop shadow, no black outline, no blur. Very quiet broad planes with few corners and varied thickness. 1536x1536 square image, opaque flat magenta background everywhere between the six subjects.
prompts.c: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a pixel-art source atlas of SIX asymmetrical broad flat FOG BANK LAYERS, two columns by three rows, separate with generous pure solid magenta #FF00FF gutters. Large square image. This is for an aerial top-down 192px map weather overlay, each donor becomes 80 to 140 pixels wide by 24 to 50 pixels tall. Deliberately quiet, natural atmospheric strata: long overlapping offset flat veils with broad recesses, tapering ends and uneven stepped contours. Each donor has a different contour and width-to-height ratio. Three or four interleaved planes per bank, soft through low contrast and broad terracing, NOT through blur. Every contour must follow a small square pixel grid. Primary colour #ADBFC5, secondary colour #C8D6D8, tertiary #E1E8E6 only a few broad thin interior patches; no white. Place secondary and tertiary planes offset, keep them away from edges and especially away from tips. About 75% muted base, 23% secondary, 2% tertiary. No dark outline. No three-dimensional volume, no cartoon clouds, no rounded lobes, no curls, no hooks, no crests, no bright ridges, no waves, no teeth, no repeating notches, no dither, no tiny details, no noise, no dots, no detached specks, no thin wisps, no brush texture or gradient. Flat solid colours only, magenta absolutely uniform. Do not paint 6 identical emblems: left/top donor long and divided, right/top short and broad, middle/left offset terraces, middle/right gently bent plane, bottom/left broad irregular broken shelf, bottom/right shallow flat ribbon. Native one-pixel stair-step edge weight. No labels, text, grid lines or terrain.
